{{Quote|Tammi, you're supposed to be in the ''learning center''.|Tammia Hollusen's Mother|<ref name="MSW30" />}}
The '''Learning Center''' was a facility on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Factory world/Legends|factory world]] of [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] where the children of factory workers would spend time and receive instruction while their parents were on work shifts. [[Tammia Hollusen]] frequently escaped the Learning Center to continue her attempts to grow [[Plant/Legends|plants]] in Metalorn's nutrient-deprived soil.<ref name="MSW30" />
